description: Get detailed configuration of a specific Global Edge CDN edge including origin, caching, and access control settings. For a CUSTOM_DOMAIN edge, the CNAME target to point the service domain at has been observed in distributionConfig.serviceDomain.cname (not documented in the guide); ncloud_edge_list_edges returns the user's own domain for such edges, not the CNAME target.
name: ncloud_edge_get_edge
